title: Conditional κ 0.00311301600 (+2.77030e-6 over #5718): paid intermediate meetings
body:
The fixed native schedule misses helper cuts that become possible after a paid intermediate meeting. This construction splits existing queries through common frames, then retires 23 independent helper inputs and supplies 23 independent continuation inputs. Eighteen cuts use one subdivision each; a three-channel meeting shares five subdivisions, and two further meetings use two each. All 27 added queries per local call are charged.

The complete conditional exponent increases from PR #5718's **0.00311024570** to **0.00311301600**: **+0.00000277030, or +0.0890701%**. The exact raw crossing is `(0.00311301604454, 0.00311301604455)`. This is below the donor's 1% target. The complete p16/a7 caller has 13,390 productive targets and 66,834 paid calls, with rank surplus 760. The extra targets require cutoff 16, floor 17, tail offset 1/7 and decay 125/128; the old completion bound is explicitly rejected. Scalar, route, owned, normalization, idle and compiler costs remain funded.

The focused package is `research/p104-paid-meeting-splits`. It contains the exact constructor and plan, proof, authenticated PR #5718 source export, retained attribution, full result and rejection controls. Validation covers all 776 public/dirty-owned columns, 2,920 native maps with exact phases, the complete physical caller, two rational interval engines, the compiler, 54 strict outer inequalities and four functional checks. Run:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-paid-meeting-splits
```

Publication commit: `8483f9a679d06c1e270141dbc686a7e76e7a7522`. Registered normal/optimized replay, metadata/source pins, committed bytes and executable modes pass. The official export has 20 package files and SHA256 `5a3046462b06c108e2853898c9daf4b466bc46f47e5f77983515b6e5e7ed5023`; export integrity passes. The separate isolated optimized replay passed in 165.589 seconds with a read-only source tree, empty PATH and no Git directory; every exported byte remained unchanged. The full-history flag is not run in the shallow checkout; both declared source commits pass direct ancestry checks. `VALIDATION.md` records the scope. Hosted CI [failed in the shared planning tests](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40355861419/job/121688015960) before package replay. `test_research_current_assignment.py` still expects the legacy command mappings after priority revision 8. Its eight failures and two errors reproduce locally; that test, both picker scripts and the catalogue are byte-identical to main. The scientific replay job was skipped. This is not a hosted scientific pass. Independent acceptance remains pending.

Constructed from canonical main `553d26d796fde9871ff2661a49ac7732e945410f`, with PR #5718 pinned at `a1534ac45401c9a9c80c07aa65c89e00e33594f8`. The publication commit is rebased onto the final upstream checkpoint at `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a` was read, including priority revision 8 and its complete helper-inventory gate. The frozen research sources are retained. The [canonical Discussion](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5600) records the claim and findings. A later overlapping investigation [released the shared scope](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5645#discussioncomment-19198871) and published a 17-split checkpoint without a duplicate PR. Its nonnested-excursion work remains separate. No global optimality or exclusive discovery claim is made.

Credit flyingviper's PR #5718, Ali Romman's PR #5713 and complete P104 caller, Joel Pulikkan/GamingPuzzled's PR #5684, the PR #5599/#5609 helper interface, the published PR #5680 cut checks, and every retained native/controller/recursion/compiler/BIT source. New work: Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.

The five inherited framework assumptions remain. The huge uniform word and complete rounded multiplier are not materialized. The selected frontier is unchanged; no merge or closure is requested.
